Rule 33: its subject is a BUILT artifact - the standard and noLegal merged Wear manifests - not a changed file, because a dependency manifest can reintroduce a permission no source file in this repository declares. A sensitive permission in the store variant reaches a user only when the Wear bundle is published, every finding names its own permission or component and the policy category that excludes it, and moving a batch of declarations costs one edit whenever it is done.
